title: POS fractional sales with price overrides
description: Validate that sales can be completed with fractional quantities, price overrides are allowed with appropriate role validation, and tax is correctly applied inclusive/exclusive per business settings.

steps.description: Login as cashier role
Navigate to POS interface
Add item with fractional quantity (e.g. 1.75 units) to cart
Apply a price override on the item
System checks that user has permission to override price; allow if valid role, reject if not
Select applicable tax setting (tax inclusive or tax exclusive) and complete sale
Verify final price and tax calculation are correct following deterministic rules
Confirm immutable sale transaction record created with audit log capturing price override and user info

title: Inventory management intake and adjustments with audit logging
description: Verify inventory intake recording creates accurate cost per unit, and inventory adjustments are audit logged with timestamp and user context without altering historical data.

steps.description: Login as Supervisor or Manager
Record inventory intake of a product with quantity and cost
Verify cost per unit is calculated correctly and intake is recorded immutably
Make an inventory adjustment (increase/decrease) for the product
Verify adjustment is saved with timestamp, user info, and does not alter prior historical intake data
Confirm adjustment action is recorded in audit logs with all context

title: Role-based authorization enforcement on APIs
description: Ensure role enforcement is validated server-side preventing unauthorized actions such as improper role assignment, price override, voids, and inventory changes.

steps.description: Attempt to perform price override and inventory adjustment as a low privilege user
System rejects unauthorized operations with appropriate error
Attempt to assign a higher role (e.g. Manager assigning Owner) via Team Management API
Role assignment request is rejected with hierarchy enforcement error
Attempt to void a transaction without sufficient role
Operation is rejected and logged

title: Audit logs retrieval with multi-faceted filtering
description: Validate that audit logs API returns append-only logs filtered accurately by business_id, action type, date range, and user.

steps.description: Login as Super Admin
Request audit logs filtered by business_id
Returned logs match only the specified tenant
Apply additional filters by action type and date range
Verify the logs returned satisfy all filter conditions accurately
Confirm audit logs are append-only (verify no log entries can be deleted or altered)
Validate only authorized roles can retrieve audit logs

title: RTBF deletion API masking PII and removing tenant roles
description: Test that RTBF deletion API permanently masks all PII fields and removes tenant roles for a user, ensuring privacy compliance.

steps.description: Login as authorized user with permission to initiate RTBF deletion
Call RTBF deletion API for a specific tenantId and userId
Verify API response confirms successful masking and role removal
Query user data from database post deletion
Confirm all personal identifiable information fields are masked or erased
Confirm tenant roles are removed with no residual access

title: Mobile POS usability: sale completion within two minutes
description: Ensure that a new staff user can complete a sale from login to final payment within two minutes using the mobile-optimized POS interface.

steps.description: Login as new cashier user on mobile device
Start timer
Complete sale with adding fractional quantities, applying valid price overrides if needed, selecting tax options, and processing payment
Stop timer after sale completion
Verify sale completion time is less than or equal to two minutes

title: Soft-disable customers and validating purchase history and notes visibility
description: Verify that customer profiles are soft-disabled (not deleted), purchase history and notes remain accessible but customer cannot be selected for new sales.

steps.description: Login as Manager
Soft-disable a customer profile
Customer is hidden or marked as disabled in customer list for new sales
Access disabled customer’s profile
Verify purchase history, notes, and status flags are visible and unaltered

title: Audit log verification for sensitive actions
description: Validate audit logs capture all sensitive actions including price overrides, inventory changes, voids, refunds, and permission modifications with correct user and timestamp details.

steps.description: Perform a price override on a sale
Make an inventory adjustment
Void a transaction
Issue a refund
Modify user permissions
Verify audit logs contain entries for each action with immutable records including user performing action, timestamp, and action details

title: Team management API enforces strict role hierarchy
description: Verify that team administrators cannot assign roles higher than their own or in violation of hierarchy rules using member create and role update APIs.

steps.description: Login as Manager-level team administrator
Attempt to add a new team member with Owner role
Request is rejected due to hierarchy violation
Attempt to update existing team member's role to Owner role
Update request is rejected enforcing role hierarchy

title: Validation of no unlogged financial or inventory changes
description: Ensure that all financial transactions and inventory changes generate corresponding audit logs with no gaps where changes occur but are not logged.

steps.description: Perform a series of transactions with sales, refunds, inventory adjustments, and role changes
Query audit logs for these specific actions
Audit logs contain entries covering every single change made with correct details; no missing logs
